integrity: All coefficients follow from explicit resistance integration and a complete edge-class comparison. A standalone exact-rational checker tests finite instances; it is not a proof of the full infinite statement. Original resistance formulas and the symmetric complete-bipartite special case are credited to prior literature or prior records, not asserted anew.
limitations: Unit-length equilateral complete multipartite metric graphs, real mean-zero first-order Sobolev energy, unnormalized arclength. No assertion for other edge lengths, vertex masses, complex or different energy exponents. Source-coverage uncertainty remains for inaccessible complete text of Gervacio (2012).
title: Minimum-degree-three localization for sharp Sobolev evaluation on complete multipartite metric graphs
